title: Favourites for signed-in customers

sourcesRead.contributes: description, technical notes (endpoints, auth, duplicate status), AC-1..AC-6, PO clarification (409 for duplicates)

actors: signed-in customer of the web shop
signed-in customer through the API (mobile app)
context: Signed-in customers can keep a personal list of favourite products, from the product page (web shop) and through the API (mobile app). (story.md#L17)

acceptanceCriteria.quote: A signed-in customer adds a product to favourites with POST /favorites; the API responds 201 with the favourite (its id and the product id).
acceptanceCriteria.text: A signed-in customer adds a product to favourites with POST /favorites; the API responds 201 with the favourite (its id and the product id).
outcomes: the response is the favourite, with its id
the response contains the product id that was added

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Adding a product that is already a favourite is rejected and the list still contains it once.
acceptanceCriteria.text: Adding a product that is already a favourite is rejected and the list still contains it once.
outcomes: adding the same product again with POST /favorites → 409 (story.md#L34, G1)

acceptanceCriteria.quote: GET /favorites lists the customer's own favourites only; another customer's favourites are never included.
acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /favorites lists the customer's own favourites only; another customer's favourites are never included.
outcomes: GET /favorites lists the customer's own favourites
GET /favorites includes no favourite of another customer

acceptanceCriteria.quote: Every favourites endpoint responds 401 without a valid token.
acceptanceCriteria.text: Every favourites endpoint responds 401 without a valid token.
outcomes: POST /favorites, GET /favorites and DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} each called with no token → 401
POST /favorites, GET /favorites and DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} each called with an invalid token → 401

acceptanceCriteria.quote: On the web shop, a signed-in customer who clicks "Add to favourites" on a product page sees "Product added to your favorites list." and the product then appears on the "Favorites" page of their account.
acceptanceCriteria.text: On the web shop, a signed-in customer who clicks "Add to favourites" on a product page sees "Product added to your favorites list." and the product then appears on the "Favorites" page of their account.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: a product page of the web shop, as a signed-in customer
outcomes: after clicking "Add to favourites", the message "Product added to your favorites list." is shown
the product appears on the "Favorites" page of the customer's account

acceptanceCriteria.quote: DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} removes the favourite (204) and it no longer appears in GET /favorites.
acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} removes the favourite (204) and it no longer appears in GET /favorites.
outcomes: the favourite no longer appears in GET /favorites

endpoints.success: 201 with the favourite (its id and the product id) (story.md#L23)
endpoints.request: body {"product_id"}; header Authorization: Bearer <token> from POST /users/login
sign-in that issues the Bearer token for the favourites endpoints

auth.mechanism: Authorization: Bearer <token> header on every favourites endpoint

rules.text: A product is a customer's favourite at most once: a duplicate favourite is rejected, and the API answers 409 Conflict (not 422 as in the technical notes).
A customer's list of favourite products is personal.

errorModel.case: adding a product that is already a favourite (duplicate favourite), through the API (status resolved by G1)
any favourites endpoint called without a valid token

outOfScope: "The web shop can keep its current message for duplicates." (story.md#L34): no expected message for a duplicate on the web shop

tried.result: L19: "Duplicate favourites are rejected with 422"; L24: "rejected" (no status); L34: PO clarification "the API must answer 409 Conflict (not 422 as in the technical notes)", explicitly superseding L19
